newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,488.4 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,488.4 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 246.7 million Swiss francs to 3,488.4 million in the reporting period ended November 8.
Statement of November 11 in millions of Swiss francs:

Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window rose by 14.9 million francs to 16.3 million in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 616.7 million francs to 2,469.3 million.

An SNB spokesman, refering to the rise in the level of sight deposits, said that "the demand from banks was greater for liquidity, and we satisfied the greater demand from the banks, which shows that we are still flexible on the money market. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
